blocks.text: You can disable the IaC scanning for selected repositories within GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos.
ZPC disables the IaC scanning and removes the selected repository from the IaC integration.

blocks.item: In the ZPC Admin Portal, go to Administration > Version Control & CI/CD Systems.
Under Version Control Systems, click the GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos tab.
Click the View icon for the account that you wish to edit.

blocks.text: The list of repositories in this account is displayed. By default, the scanning is enabled for all repositories.

blocks.item: Click the toggle under the Scanning column to disable the scanning.
A confirmation message appears. Click Disable to proceed.

blocks.text: Any scanning that is currently in progress is completed, then the IaC scanning is disabled for the repository.
